description: This file defines a RecyclerView adapter ('ContentRowAdapter') for rendering a list of content rows, each containing a title and a horizontal list of content cards. It manages focus behavior to ensure the row title is visible when navigating via DPAD or focus events, and uses DiffUtil for efficient updates.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter
classes.description: Adapter to render a list of content rows, each with a title and a horizontal list of content cards.

classes.name: ContentRowAdapter.RowVH
classes.description: ViewHolder for individual content row, handles focus events to ensure the row title remains visible when intra-row focus changes.

methods.name: submitList
methods.description: Updates the list of ContentRow items in the adapter efficiently using DiffUtil.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Inflates the item_content_row layout and creates a ViewHolder.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the ViewHolder for a given position.

methods.name: RowVH.bind
methods.description: Binds a ContentRow object to the ViewHolder, setting the title and configuring the inner RecyclerView with focus management behavior.
